title: Tractive Sleepy-Day Location Radius Collapse
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tractive:location
| bin _time span=1d
| stats dc(zone_name) as zones_visited, max(distance_m) as max_distance_m by pet _time
| where zones_visited=1 AND max_distance_m<200
| sort max_distance_m
description: Uses Tractive location history telemetry to monitor days when a pet barely moved around its normal zones in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for routines that look unusually sedentary, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tractive location history data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals days when a pet barely moved around its normal zones so you can spot routines that look unusually sedentary before it becomes annoying.
